workbench.layouts.matrix1.description: Content fills the window; navigation floats above the content (good for matrix).

workbench.layouts.matrix2.description: Reserved “layout 2” for matrix (currently identical to the default overlay layout).
workbench.layouts.stack.title: Stack Layout
workbench.layouts.stack.description: Content fills the window; navigation floats above the content.
workbench.layouts.splitLeft.title: Split Layout (Navigation Left)
workbench.layouts.splitLeft.description: Fixed navigation on the left; content on the right.
workbench.navigations.none.title: No Navigation
workbench.navigations.pagesList.title: Pages List
workbench.navigations.pagesList.descript: Shows the pages list for quick switching.
workbench.pageContainers.matrix.title: Matrix (With Editor)
workbench.pageContainers.matrix.descript: Matrix main UI (includes editor overlay and editor panel).
Only renders the Navigation Page (as magnets).
workbench.workbenches.default.title: Default Workbench (Composed)
workbench.workbenches.default.descriptio: Composed from Layout / Navigation / Content; recommended for daily use.
workbench.workbenches.minimal.title: Minimal Workbench
workbench.workbenches.minimal.descriptio: Directly renders the Matrix (hides editor overlay/panel); ignores the composed settings below.
